detail.longDescription: i'm still working on the dns setup, it's going a bit slowly, because while i've been so far able to prevent viruses from breaching my infrastructure, i haven't been able to prevent them from breaching my body. i've started working on adding a controller that watches gateway api routes and registers the neccessary DNS entries for them. i was hoping there would be some standard way to do a mapping between a route and ip addresses that listen for that route, but apparently no, you have to manualy traverse the parents of the route and find the gateways. honestly, the whole gateway api isn't really anything more than a pile of json schemas describing all the various objects. everything else is left to the implementers. but it's fine, i will do the same thing that external-dns does so at least it won't be more broken than the official solution. #shibari #bondage #kubernetes #dns
